dedupe_keys.name: mecklenburg western pomerania subsidised broadband infrastructure planned and built fibre routes wms

description: The broadband competence centre of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania publishes a web map service of the fibre optic and duct routes built or planned under the subsidised broadband expansion in the German state. The service has two layers: routes planned (Trassenbau geplant) and routes built (Trassenbau umgesetzt). The metadata record on the German spatial data infrastructure describes it as information on the planned and implemented fibre optic or duct line infrastructure of the subsidised expansion. Coverage: Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, Germany, subsidised projects only, as line features. Format and access: OGC WMS map service, free; the licence is not stated on the capabilities read, and no WFS download was found. Caveats: map images only through WMS, not vector downloads; covers state-funded routes and not commercial networks; update dates not checked. Simulation uses: routes of new rural fibre for flood and storm exposure of access networks and for planning redundancy. Related records: data-breitbandatlas-germany gives national coverage by technology; data-bnetza-mobilfunk-monitoring gives mobile coverage.
